paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma Yashan, Naso (section) 20, and perhaps he is R' Shimon ben Yosina.[^1]

notes.text: נשא-כ gives Naso 20 as a locator reading, with section an explanatory English gloss rather than a verified edition scheme. Older machine נשא״ב differs from supplied נשא-כ. ר״ש is contextually Shimon from the same notice, with title component R'. The possible Asini/Yosina identification retains Hyman’s perhaps; no identity is admitted. The heading title likewise remains R'.
